workflow.name: Implementation Workflow
workflow.purpose: Turns one exact frozen, implementation-authorizing design into a VERIFIED_IMPLEMENTATION_READY feature-branch candidate through Goal Graph, Test Ladder and evolutionary TDD; preserves every upstream obligation semantic while owning its own lifecycle classification, Actions, Gates and terminal effects.

fields.name: design
fields.description: Frozen upstream design binding: identity, content identity, IMPLEMENTATION_READY status, scope, referenced Contracts and obligations. A design-semantic change stops the Delivery.

fields.name: intake
fields.description: IM-01 result: authorityBound, designIdentityExact, obligationRegisterBound, derivableFactMissing, blockers.

fields.name: obligationRegister
fields.description: Classified upstream obligations (CONTRACT_PREREQUISITE / IMPLEMENTATION_FEASIBILITY / IMPLEMENTATION_VERIFICATION / OPERATIONAL_TUNING) with preserved semantic dependency and reopen condition.

fields.name: preflight
fields.description: IM-02 result: passed, feasibilityObligations (count), harnessBinding, contractAvailability facts, blockers.

fields.name: feasibility
fields.description: IM-02V result: allCalibrated, pendingWithProgress, externalUnavailable, reopen, evidence identity.

fields.name: grilling
fields.description: IM-03 result: allClassified, needsUser, ambiguity, projectContextSnapshot, goalPackets.

fields.name: goalGraph
fields.description: IM-04 result: frozen (bool), correctionRequired (bool), goals, dependencies, ladders, completion relation.

fields.name: branch
fields.description: IM-05 result: activated (bool), baseline identity, feature branch identity.

fields.name: selection
fields.description: IM-06 deterministic selector result: goalRungReady, allGoalsCommitted, missingContract, selected goal/rung or exact wait/terminal proposal.

fields.name: currentGoal
fields.description: Exact loop position: current Goal id.

fields.name: currentRung
fields.description: Exact loop position: current Test Ladder rung id.

fields.name: ladder
fields.description: Test Ladder feedback for the current rung: calibrated, ambiguity, expectedRedProgress, green, branchRedIntroduced, branchesClosed, regression, noRefactorOrGreen, anotherRung, verified, invalidFeedback.

fields.name: returnAction
fields.description: Recorded owning Action for dynamic returns: IM-01R returns to its recorded requester; IM-11 invalid feedback returns to the recorded owning Action; SD-style return_action routing.

fields.name: review
fields.description: Review state: barrierReached, finding (none|test|implementation), findingOpen, goalScopeFindingClosed, wholeScopeFindingClosed.

fields.name: findings
fields.description: Admitted review findings; appended, never overwritten; dispositions closed only by the source lens.

fields.name: commit
fields.description: IM-16 result: verifiedGoalCommitted (bool), Goal commit identity, new baseline.

fields.name: regressionWhole
fields.description: IM-17 result: passed (bool), wholeScopeFindingAdmitted (bool), regression evidence.

fields.name: terminalGate
fields.description: IM-18 result: passed (bool), final candidate identity, verification summary, operational-tuning handoffs.

fields.name: attempts
fields.description: Attempt accounting: each retry gains a new attempt identity; repeating the same failure without new diagnosis consumes budget; numeric limit is project/runtime policy and never relaxes a Gate.

fields.name: gitBaseline
fields.description: Clean starting baseline; never auto-stash/reset/merge.

fields.name: currentTree
fields.description: Current candidate Git tree identity for checkpoint binding.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Lifecycle marker; 'unknown' triggers the intervention recovery path.

terminals.meaning: All in-scope Goals verified and committed; both reviews and whole-scope regression pass; terminal Gate passes; no push/PR/merge/deploy unless separately authorized.
Budget exhausted or external authority missing; records current Goal/rung, Git baseline, test results, attempts, Findings and exact resume Action; never relaxes a Gate.
Explicit durable cancellation; cannot be reported as success or incomplete.
Non-retryable configuration or execution failure; current artifacts and failure evidence preserved.

A measured feasibility result or upstream semantic change crosses a frozen design-reopen condition: the current Delivery stops and a new Delivery requires a new design version. No local substitution of authority.

waits.purpose: One measurement/intent decision required by adaptive grilling (IM-03); exactly one decision per wait.
Explicit whole-Brief/goal-graph confirmation (IM-04); human confirms, executor persists the exact frozen artifacts.
A selected Goal requires a missing cross-owner Contract/design artifact (IM-06); a compatible result resumes IM-03 classification; a result that changes design semantics stops the Delivery.
IM-02V requires an external authority/environment fact the current Delivery cannot produce; resumes IM-02V when available.

handoffs.domainSemantics: The VERIFIED_IMPLEMENTATION_READY candidate establishes which in-scope Goals of the frozen design were implemented and verified, with exact evidence identities and a bounded verification summary.
handoffs.invalidationConditions: A later design-semantic change, a later measurement contradicting the frozen scope, or an unmeasured operational-tuning value presented as passed invalidates the claim.
handoffs.semanticDependency: The consuming Workflow must not treat unmeasured values as passed evidence and must not treat the candidate as merged/pushed/deployed.
handoffs.requiredEvidence: Exact branch/head/change-set identity and bounded verification summary with evidence identities.
handoffs.reopenCondition: A measured fact contradicts the frozen design semantic dependency.

preservesSemantics.semanticDependency: A cross-owner, versioned Contract is a prerequisite for a reliable Oracle/integration; a missing Contract blocks only dependent Goals and is obtained through external coordination.
preservesSemantics.reopenCondition: The Contract or its version changes such that the frozen dependency is no longer satisfied.

preservesSemantics.semanticDependency: Dependency versions, SDK/API and local substrate suitability must be calibrated by the current implementation before Goal freeze; an invalidated direction stops the Delivery.
preservesSemantics.reopenCondition: A measured feasibility result contradicts a frozen design semantic dependency.

preservesSemantics.semanticDependency: Verification evidence must be produced by the current implementation and its conformance/fault tests; unexecuted evidence is never reported as passed.
preservesSemantics.reopenCondition: A measured implementation fact contradicts a frozen design semantic dependency.

preservesSemantics.semanticDependency: Operational tuning values are measurable only with a runnable candidate and representative environment; they remain an explicit owner-complete handoff and never block VERIFIED_IMPLEMENTATION_READY unless a frozen Fitness Threshold applies.
preservesSemantics.reopenCondition: A measured tuning value violates a frozen design assumption.

budgets.accounting: each retry gains a new attempt identity; repeating the same failure without new diagnosis consumes budget; runtime invokes the evaluator registration point to obtain the budget conclusion; numeric limits are never configured; exhaustion never relaxes a Gate
